image_description: A large, silver-grey airship (dirigible) hovering low over a body of water with a tree line in the background. The airship features a streamlined, cigar-shaped envelope with a blue and yellow stripe running horizontally. A gondola is suspended beneath the forward section. There is text visible on the side of the envelope. The sky is overcast.
